rationale: Both role-isolated advisory inputs were present from distinct runs and model families, pinned to the same frozen candidate. The academic review returned request-changes with seven majors; the learning-design review approved. No finding carried blocking severity and every one was correctable here, so all were disposed in one finalization pass. Three deserve naming. The lesson keyed a statement of temporal sequence as a causal explanation, which taught the post hoc inference in the act of warning against it. The worked example asserted that an attribution was absent and then supplied it. And the wrap-up claimed an explanation cannot be acted on, which is false and contradicted an earlier scene of the same lesson; the real danger is that unsupported causal explanations are acted on readily and narrow what anyone looks for afterwards. A fourth was structural rather than wrong: the lesson's central six-way taxonomy had no claim record, and is now declared as the lesson's own convention rather than passing as a sourced finding. The academic verdict stands as dissent; no reviewer has seen the repaired text.
dissent: The academic review's request-changes verdict stands as material dissent from the candidate as reviewed. Its findings were incorporated by the maintainer afterwards and no reviewer has approved the result.
conditions: The repaired content is committed first and that commit is stamped as finalCommit, with no teaching-content change afterward.
Strict source preflight and full validation must pass on the final content before merge.
The publication transition is the maintainer's separate act and is not authorised by this decision.

evidenceChecked: All eight scenes keep one level-one heading, semantic Markdown, linear reading order and text-first instruction, with no raw HTML, embeds or executable content.
The pack carries no images or diagrams, so no alternative-text obligation arises; the repaired sorting tables remain readable in linear order.
All nine sources are used facts-only with no reuse of source expression, and the serotonin dispute is presented from both sides.
Every repair narrows a claim to its evidence or removes an assertion, which lowers rather than raises the pack's accuracy exposure.
limitations: A maintainer reading of the repaired text, not an independent accessibility or rights review; the accessibility-rights role was not staffed for this tier.
No screen-reader run was performed against the rendered lesson.
The cross-course distinct-sense declaration on interpretation is left standing as a deliberate protest against the premed usage; a future terminology adjudication may rule differently.
The six-way taxonomy is now declared as a convention rather than sourced, which is honest but means the lesson's central model rests on the maintainer's judgement that it is a useful cut.
